text:
alice.j: Quick heads-up — runtime/infra and console teams need to handshake on a new "isolation score" we're surfacing per customer. Thinking of combining queue depth, tail latency, GPU smearing (per-tenant pct), and KV-cache hit delta. Need alignment on event shapes and rollouts.

bob.m: +1. do we have a proposal for the event schema? is this going into raw logs or a metrics pipeline?

carol_r: We should send both: high-cardinality telemetry to the ingest pipeline (kafka) as events, and aggregated timeseries to metrics (prom / trappy). That lets console do per-org rollups without reprocessing raw.

alice.j: Proposal sketch: single event "tenant_isolation_signal" with fields: tenant_id, region, model_family, trace_id (optional), q_depth, q_tail_ms_p95, gpu_util_pct, kv_cache_miss_rate, timestamp. We'll include a small "signal_type" enum to indicate noisy_neighbor vs quota_throttle vs cold_start.

bob.m: can we get a sample proto/json? I want to ensure downstream parsers can map to existing dashboards.

carol_r: Sure — minimal example:
```json
{
  "event": "tenant_isolation_signal",
  "tenant_id": "org_1234",
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "model_family": "gptx-13b",
  "signal_type": "noisy_neighbor",
  "q_depth": 18,
  "q_tail_ms_p95": 720,
  "gpu_util_pct": 87.3,
  "kv_cache_miss_rate": 0.22,
  "timestamp": "2026-03-18T16:12:10Z"
}
```

dave_ops: That looks good. A few operational notes: 1) we must cap tenant_id cardinality in metrics backend — keep raw events in kafka/raw lake, but produce hashed_tenant_id for long retention timeseries. 2) Include a sampling hint so high-volume tenants can be sampled at 1% for raw payloads.

erin_prod: UX ask: in console we want a per-org "isolation timeline" showing the isolation score and the top contributing signals. Need the mapping from event fields -> buckets in the UI. Also need a derived score definition (0-100).

alice.j: Suggested derived score: weighted sum: 0.4 * normalized(q_tail_p95) + 0.25 * normalized(gpu_util) + 0.2 * normalized(q_depth) + 0.15 * normalized(kv_miss). We'll share the normalizers by region/model_family. We should version the formula (v1) so rollbacks are easy.

bob.m: How do we avoid leaking customer PII when making per-org dashboards visible to SRE? Access controls matter. Also for beta customers who opt-in, we can show org names; otherwise show truncated/hashes.

carol_r: Agreed on access controls. The ingest should set a flag `pii_level` per event; console will only display identifying info if `pii_level == public` and the caller has the org view permission. Defaults are `private`.

telemetry-bot: New schema registered: tenant_isolation_signal v1 -> topics: telemetry.raw.signals, metrics.realtime.isolation (aggregates)

dave_ops: Rollout plan suggestion: 1) implement producer in runtime (small lib) + tests, 2) stream to kafka (dev/stage), 3) make aggregator jobs that emit 1m/5m/1h aggregates (hashed_tenant_id), 4) console feature flag + canary for 3 internal customers, 5) open beta to self-serve customers.

erin_prod: Can we add a console UX flow for "why is my org flagged" — a drilldown that shows correlated high latencies, recent config changes, routing fallbacks, and top requests contributing to queue depth (sampled). That'll make it actionable.

alice.j: Agree. Need runtime traces for fallback events. Example fallback log line to include: `fallback_event: { tenant_id, request_id, from_model: "gptx-13b", to_model: "gptx-6b-quant", reason: "capacity_spike", timestamp }`. Include count of fallbacks per window.

bob.m: Quotas interplay: if we surface isolation score, product may want to auto-throttle noisy tenants. We need policy knobs in routing: `isolation_score_threshold` and `cooldown_window`. We should keep a manual override per-tenant.

carol_r: For metrics retention: keep 1m aggregates for 90 days, 5m for 365 days, and hashed long-term for 3 years. Raw events to blob storage for 30 days by default. Also include a TTL override for enterprise customers.

dave_ops: Ops ask: add alerting rules for when isolation_score > 80 for any tenant for 5m (pager to eng-oncall). Also auto-create an incident with suggested mitigations (move to model variant, increase batch size, enable per-tenant rate limit).

erin_prod: UX note: in rollout we should hide the "isolation_score" by default and expose opt-in toggle per workspace, then surface suggested fixes and a "request assistance" CTA to solutions-engineering.

alice.j: Tasks: @bob.m create producer lib PR (runtime) by EOD Tue. @carol_r add schema to registry and start aggregator job draft. @dave_ops write alerting playbook draft. @erin_prod prototype console mockups and identify required API endpoints.

bob.m: On it. I'll post a link to the PR when ready.

carol_r: I'll add hashing/sampling code in the aggregator and a mapping table for normalizers per model_family.

telemetry-bot: Created ticket INF-4221 "tenant isolation signals - schema + pipeline" assigned to carol_r, bob.m, dave_ops, erin_prod

alice.j: Thanks all. Let's sync Thursday 10am to walk the mockups + schema. If anyone needs pre-sync notes please ping me. :thumbsup:
